prompt:
Subject: The reverse of an Indian one-rupee coin from the 2011 rupee-symbol series.

Composition: Show one round silver-colored steel Indian one-rupee coin leaning against the rim of a shallow wooden coin tray. Its visible reverse follows the 2011 rupee-symbol design: '₹' above a large '1', lotus buds and flowers with stems and leaves on both sides, and the small year '2011' below; keep the complete coin unobstructed.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. Allow only the authentic denomination symbol '₹', numeral '1', and mint year '2011' on the coin. No other text or numerals. No incidental labels, logos or watermark.
For each human: exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands.
en: An Indian one-rupee coin rests against a wooden tray.
